opening.argument: The presentation promotes Project Ethereum as a paid matrix in which participants depend on recruiting new members for purported returns. It says, "you'll receive your first donation when the next person joins your team," and specifies that someone joining below will send $90 of Ethereum directly to the participant. The displayed stages extend payments across multiple levels above the participant and present up to $4.8 million per month in ETH donations. The paid membership also includes crypto courses, showing that recruitment commissions and tiered payments are central to the offer while training is packaged alongside them.
